title: Quantitative Versus qUAlitative NeuromoniToring of neUroMuscular Block for Non-cardiothoracic Surgery
official: Quantitative Versus qUAlitative NeuromoniToring of neUroMuscular Block for Non-cardiothoracic Surgery (The QUANTUM Trial): Single-center Cluster Randomized Multiple Crossover Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the effect of quantitative block monitoring versus less expensive qualitative monitoring treatment effects on the lowest SpO2/FiO2 ratio in the PACU. The results will be incorporated into an enhanced recovery pathway for surgical patients.
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston

sites.f: The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
